title: Instructions Index
content:
Part of the whole-Bible instruction study

Laws, Commands, and Instructions covers both Testaments. Browse the Old Testament catalogue and the New Testament catalogue for the wider study.

Index coverage: the table below is the earlier index of 1,223 Torah records, 105 Christ studies and 124 apostolic teachings. The current main Torah catalogue has 1,252 indexed requirements; the 29 later additions are not yet synchronized here. The expanded Old Testament passage register and selected supplemental records are accessed through the book catalogues. These overlapping collections do not constitute a single count of unique biblical commands.

Instructions Index

Read Instructions · Instructions index · Beyond the Torah · Counting and classification guide

Find the existing research by ID, subject, biblical reference, named recipient or classification. This index covers 1,223 Torah requirements, 105 Christ studies and 124 apostolic teachings. These collections overlap and count different kinds of material; their numbers must not be added together as a count of unique biblical commands.

The Torah classifications reproduce the consolidated Instructions document. Christ studies and apostolic teachings retain their own contexts and have not been automatically assigned a Torah classification. Some teaching entries describe doctrine or promises rather than separately actionable commands. K and A labels are index aliases for the existing k and a entry anchors; original links remain valid.

The recipient column repeats an explicit name or role when the source summary states one. “See passage and setting” means that the recipient must be established from the full entry and Scripture; it does not mean the instruction applies to everyone.
